Name: Weaknesses Addressed by the OWASP Golang Secure Coding Practices Guide
Objective: CWE entries in this view (slice) are fully or partially eliminated by following the guidance presented in the OWASP Golang Secure Coding Practices Guide.

Audience.Description: By following this coding guide, Go developers will be able to fully or partially prevent the weaknesses that are identified in this view. In addition, developers can use a CWE coverage graph to determine which weaknesses are not directly addressed by the guide, which will help identify and resolve remaining gaps in training, tool acquisition, or other approaches for reducing weaknesses.
If a software developer claims to be following this coding guide, then customers can search for the weaknesses in this view in order to formulate independent evidence of that claim.
Educators can use this view in multiple ways. For example, if there is a focus on teaching weaknesses, the educator could link them to this relevant Secure Coding Guide.

MappingNotes.Rationale: This entry is a View. Views are not weaknesses and therefore inappropriate to describe the root causes of vulnerabilities.
MappingNotes.Comments: Use this View or other Views to search and navigate for the appropriate weakness.

Notes.Note: The relationships in this view were determined based on specific statements within the rules from the guide. Not all rules have direct relationships to individual weaknesses, although they likely have chaining relationships in specific circumstances.

The CWE mappings within this guide are not complete. Some suggestions might not have clearly related weanesses, or there may be some CWE gaps.
